text:
Terrible experience getting a nose job here last April. They used a misleading promotion. I paid a 1000 baht deposit, but didn't even get to talk to the doctor. The staff upgraded the silicone implant, adding blah blah blah, almost 20,000 baht more. They said they would support the tip, but they didn't. The doctor, Dr. J, flew in from Bangkok. As soon as he entered the room, he said my nose was too wide. To make it look good, I needed an open rhinoplasty. He asked, "Do you have the money? If you have money, fly to Bangkok and get it done. But today, this is all I can do. If you don't want to do it, go home." What?! Was that really what the doctor said? I didn't even get a chance to say I didn't want to do it.
After the procedure, my nose base was floating. I messaged the admin, and they said I had to wait for the cartilage to settle, which would take 8 months. I asked the admin again, and they said it was because of my original nose base. Hello, my old nose wasn't floating! I'm not trying to demand anything, but I want to warn others to be careful.
